currentParagraphText: “I do hope they haven’t stagnated in my absence,” the King said.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “I do hope they haven’t stagnated in my absence,” the King said.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Though it doesn’t feel like it has been that long since I fell. You will have to bring me up to speed about what happened since and what you’ve been up to.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “They’re all here, and I’m already way ahead of you,” Jake smiled, knowing what the King was about to ask. He knew the Unique Lifeform didn’t really like other people, but he at least did respect the ones he’d spent fifty years with inside Nevermore. Especially his fellow monster, Sylphie, but then again, everyone tended to like Sylphie.
